_comment: The game calendar and how long things take, in game time. Playback speed (real seconds per game year) is in settings.json. 'news_travel_days': someone resting at home hears that nominations or voting have opened within this many days. 'start_after_dawn': the game begins this share of a day-night cycle after dawn. 'office_grace_life_days': someone who has just taken an office (by election, appointment, persuasion or challenge) can't be persuaded against, challenged or voted out for this many day-night cycles: a chance to prove themselves.

while_busy._comment: Politics runs on days, work on hours of the day-night cycle, so they don't get in each other's way: someone busy with one of 'during' (work, craft, wait = resting at home, care:<action>) may still do 'actions' at once, without breaking off what they are doing. NPCs consider it every 'npc_check_days' days while busy when a ballot or challenge waits on them, otherwise every 'npc_check_days_otherwise' days. Talking to someone on the side (canvass, rally, a speech) still takes its time: the next such talk waits until the last one would have ended.
